title: Pullback scalar comparison in normalized total-limit coordinates
statement: Fix l,E,L,iota, schemes X,Y, f:X→Y with l invertible, completed-operation models ME,ML, normalized scalar realizations SX,SY, an integral constructible M on Y, and completeness of its E pullback [def-pur-scalar-extension-tower-data]. Compose the actual scalarPullbackCompleted hom with the L pullback realization and total limit of L pullback applied to scalarReduction_Y. This equals the scalar realization at the E pullback of M, followed by total limit of sequence scalar applied to pullbackReduction_E and then the specified derived scalar/pullback association. This equation is in the ambient completed-coefficient derived category, before transposition through the reduction/limit adjunction; it asserts neither the tensor equation nor existence of any models.

proof.text: Apply the strict quotient square and then the normalized total-limit assembly theorem. The latter uses the scalar and pullback normalization fields, the coherent K-flat presentation, Roos-bridge naturality, and localization along the representative comparison.

theorem scalarTowerPullbackLimitSquare (W : Bool → Scheme.{u})
    (ME : CompletedOperations.Models.{u, u} l E W)
    (ML : CompletedOperations.Models.{u, u} l L W)
    (SX : IntegralComparisonScalarModel.{u, u} l E L ι (W true)
      (ME.calculus true) (ML.roos true))
    (SY : IntegralComparisonScalarModel.{u, u} l E L ι (W false)
      (ME.calculus false) (ML.roos false))
    (f : W true ⟶ W false)
    (_hX : IsUnit (l : Γ(W true, ⊤))) (_hY : IsUnit (l : Γ(W false, ⊤)))
    (M : sfIntegralConstructibleCategory l E (W false))
    (hF : IsSfDerivedComplete l E (W true)
      ((integralDerivedPullback.{u, u} l E f).obj M.obj)) :
    (scalarPullbackCompleted l E L ι f M.obj M.property.1 hF).hom ≫
        (ML.pullback f).realization.hom.app
          ((integralScalarExtension.{u} l E L ι (W false)).obj M.obj) ≫
        (coefficientSequenceLimit.{u, u} l L (W true)).map
          ((integralComparisonDerivedSequencePullback.{u, u} l L f).map
            (scalarReduction l E L ι (W false) (ME.calculus false) (ML.calculus false)
              (ML.roos false) SY M.obj)) =
      SX.realization.hom.app ((integralDerivedPullback.{u, u} l E f).obj M.obj) ≫
        (coefficientSequenceLimit.{u, u} l L (W true)).map
          ((integralComparisonDerivedSequenceScalar.{u, u} l E L ι (W true)).map
            (pullbackReduction l E W ME f M.obj) ≫
          (integralComparisonSystemScalarPullback.{u, u} l E L ι f).hom.app
            ((ME.calculus false).reduction.obj M.obj))
